{{Quote|Let's show these clankers how to fly.|Ghost Leader|<ref name="SW:RS" />}}
'''Ghost Leader''' was a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who served as leader of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Ghost Squadron]]. During a mission to escort [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Kharrus/Legends|Kharrus]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]], they were attacked by [[Vulture-class starfighter|vulture droids]], forcing Ghost Squadron to defend the senator.

==Biography==
===Taking flight===
{{Quote|Master Kenobi... Ghost Squadron... damage is critical! I'm heading to the escape pod!|Senator Kharrus|<ref name="SW:RS" />}}
[[File:GhostSquadronEscort.png|thumb|left|300px|Ghost Squadron escort Senator Kharrus' cruiser to the planet Kinyen.]]
The [[clone trooper]] who would fly under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] Ghost Leader<ref name="SW:RS" /> was created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] from the [[Clone template/Legends|clone template]] of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="db" /> Trained<ref name="Pilot">{{DB|organization|clonetrooperpilots|clone trooper pilots}}</ref> as a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]], they would serve in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]] as leader of the [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] known as [[Ghost Squadron]]. Serving the Republic, they fought in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="SW:RS" />

During the war, Ghost Squadron was tasked with escorting the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Kharrus/Legends|Kharrus]] to his [[Homeworld/Legends|home planet]] of [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]] for negotiations. As the senator prepared for arrival, they were ambushed by [[Vulture-class starfighter|vulture droids]]. With the aid of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], Ghost Leader commanded Ghost Squadron as they attempted to protect Senator Kharrus at all costs. During the [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfight]], the [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|Republic cruiser]] Kharrus was aboard sustained too much damage, forcing the senator to evacuate in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]].<ref name="SW:RS" />

===Battleship===
{{Quote|Look at the size of that thing. We've got no chance against firepower of that magnitude!''"<br />"''Cut the chatter Green Five, we've got to buy General Kenobi some time on the ground. Draw those fighters away from the battleship - it's our only chance.|Green Five and Ghost Leader|<ref name="SW:RS" />}}
[[File:RepublicSquadronLucrehulk.png|thumb|right|300px|Ghost Squadron encounter a Separatist ''Lucrehulk''-class battleship.]]
With the senator's escape pod landing on Kinyen, Obi-Wan Kenobi ordered Ghost Squadron to pursue the vulture [[Droid/Legends|droids]] while he located the senator. Chasing down the droids, Ghost Squadron eventually found themselves in a trap once they realized they had been led to a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]]. Not standing a chance against the ''Lucrehulk'', [[Green Five (clone pilot)|Green Five]] expressed their dismay, to which Ghost Leader told the clone [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] to cut the chatter and ordered the squadron to draw the fighters away from the battleship in order to buy Kenobi some [[Time/Legends|time]] on the ground. As the dogfight ensued, Ghost Squadron was quickly overwhelmed, and with no other option, Ghost Leader ordered the squadron to fly through the nearby [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] in hopes of losing the vulture droids.<ref name="SW:RS" />

The squadron raced towards the asteroid field, fighting droids on their way. Upon reaching the field, Ghost Squadron began maneuvering around the asteroids until they received a message from General Kenobi who had located the senator and sent the squadron their coordinates. Unable to lose the vulture droids in the asteroid field, General Kenobi notified the squadron about a small Republic outpost just below their position where they could acquire a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Republic attack gunship]]. Fleeing to the outpost, the remaining members of Ghost Squadron commandeered a [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] and made their way back to Kinyen to evacuate Senator Kharrus and General Kenobi.<ref name="SW:RS" />

==Personality and traits==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of Jango Fett,<ref name="db" /> Ghost Leader had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin<ref name="Skin" /> and stood at a height of 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="db" />

==Skills and abilities==
As a clone [[pilot]],<ref name="SW:RS" /> Ghost Leader received cross-training with all [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] standard to the Republic Navy.<ref name="Pilot" /> They used their leadership skills to command the pilots of Ghost Squadron.<ref name="SW:RS" />

==Equipment==
Ghost Leader wore clone pilot [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]] adorned with the [[Republic crest/Legends|Republic insignia]]. They flew a V-19 Torrent starfighter.<ref name="SW:RS" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:RepublicSquadron-ErroneousGhostLeader.png|thumb|right|250px|Ghost Leader depicted with the wrong armor.]]
Ghost Leader appeared in a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] in the first of five campaigns of the [[2009]] [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Handheld_TV_game plug and play] motion flight [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Plug it in and Play: Motion Flight Game: Star Wars: Republic Squadron|Star Wars: Republic Squadron]]'', created by [[JAKKS Pacific]] and developed by [[HotGen Limited]]. There is one instance in the campaign, at the beginning of the second mission, where Ghost Leader is erroneously depicted as a clone trooper in non-pilot [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]].<ref name="SW:RS" />
